{
  "architect_scope": "one-R31-structural-factor-only",
  "proposal_mode": "counter_hypothesis",
  "qualitative_hypothesis": {
    "observed_bottleneck": "Provenance-blind terminal authority must interpret validity-sensitive candidate semantics without directly seeing the anchor policy whose departures shaped those semantics.",
    "causal_change": "Introduce one direct anchor-policy re-entry edge at final emission, replacing evidence deprivation with contract-grounded contrast while preserving the complete executable predecessor lineage.",
    "expected_effect": "Terminal authority can distinguish intentional departures from accidental incompatibilities, supporting more reliable contract-valid emission and more deliberate adaptation and scan-resistance behavior.",
    "falsifier": "all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score"
  },
  "structural_mutation": {
    "change_count": 1,
    "factor": "terminal anchor-policy re-entry as a direct contrastive evidence edge",
    "before": "The final authority sees the executable predecessor and public obligations but cannot see anchor_policy.",
    "after": "The final authority sees the executable predecessor and anchor_policy concurrently, using the anchor only as contrastive evidence governed by public obligations.",
    "why_structural": "The mutation adds one previously forbidden external evidence edge across the terminal provenance boundary, changing final-call visibility and discrepancy-resolution behavior without adding candidates or roles."
  },
  "mode_certificate": {
    "rejected_assumptions": [
      "Terminal independence requires anchor-policy blindness.",
      "A self-contained executable closure is sufficient evidence for attributing every validity-sensitive semantic departure.",
      "Withholding contrasting construction evidence inherently improves final semantic judgment."
    ],
    "forbidden_inherited_mechanism": "terminal anchor-policy occlusion enforced by the post-construction provenance firewall",
    "independent_replacement_principle": "contrastive accountability through concurrent visibility of the complete executable candidate and anchor-policy evidence, with public obligations holding adjudicative authority",
    "changed_behavioral_dimensions": [
      "contract-valid emission behavior under ambiguous semantic departures",
      "phase-shift adaptation behavior",
      "scan-resistance behavior"
    ],
    "counter_until_promotion": true
  },
  "candidate_structure": {
    "name": "Anchor-Reentrant Executable Contrast Relay",
    "organization": "two-call sequential lineage with one direct terminal anchor-policy re-entry edge",
    "information_flow": "The first call forms one complete executable closure from all common inputs. The final call consumes that closure while independently receiving anchor_policy and public obligations, attributes discrepancies through contract-grounded contrast, and emits one policy.",
    "stages": [
      {
        "id": "contrast_relay",
        "mode": "sequential",
        "calls": [
          {
            "id": "form_executable_closure",
            "role": "executable semantic closure former",
            "objective": "Form exactly one complete executable policy closure grounded in the supplied evidence and public obligations, and pass the entire policy-bearing artifact forward.",
            "inputs": [
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "executable_policy_closure"
          },
          {
            "id": "contrastive_policy_authority",
            "role": "contrast-visible final semantic authority",
            "objective": "Consume the complete preceding executable closure, use the concurrently visible anchor policy only to identify and attribute semantic departures against public obligations, reconcile validity within the single lineage, and emit one complete policy.",
            "inputs": [
              "form_executable_closure",
              "task",
              "anchor_policy",
              "anchor_contract",
              "task_constraints",
              "candidate_hypothesis",
              "loop_structure"
            ],
            "output_type": "policy"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "final_call_id": "contrastive_policy_authority"
  },
  "compliance": {
    "one_structural_factor_only": true,
    "score_or_trace_content_used": false,
    "policy_code_emitted": false,
    "variants_sampling_or_best_of_n_emitted": false,
    "hardcoding_emitted": false
  }
}
